title: Proud Father with Baby in Pram, 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A touching domestic snapshot showing a proud, smiling young father standing on the front walk next to a classic mid-century baby carriage holding his two-month-old infant, Frank. The father wears a neat zip-up jacket and tailored trousers, with his hair carefully styled in late 1940s fashion. They are positioned just outside the brick exterior of their suburban home, with house number '13325' visible near the doorway, reflecting the post-WWII American baby boom era.
